name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 17, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation for Workplace Gender Equity Day
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the March 13, 2019 Regular Meeting, March 13, 2019 Special Meeting, March 20, 2019 Regular Meeting, March 20, 2019 Special Meeting, March 27, 2019 Regular Meeting, March 27, 2019 Special Meeting, and Special Joint Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-04-17 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-04-17 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Cardiff 101 Main Street for a community special event. Contact Person: Special Events and Projects Supervisor Buck
Approve a one-year Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and Cardiff 101 Main Street in substantial form in consultation with the City Attorney to host the 14th Annual Cardiff Dog Days of Summer on Sunday, August 13, 2019, at Encinitas Community Park.
2019-04-17 Item 08C Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Cardiff 101 Main Street
8D.
New Cyclovia Open Street City Special Event. Contact Person: Special Events and Projects Supervisor Buck
Approve a new City Special Event to be held on Sunday, January 12, 2020, 10 a.m. - 2 p.m. on South Coast Highway 101 between D Street and J Street.
2019-04-17 Item 08D New Cyclovia Open Street City Special Event
8E.
Construction of the Downtown Cardiff Accessibility Improvements (CS18H). Contact Person: Civil Engineer Milligan
Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a construction agreement with LC Paving and Sealing, Inc. in substantial form, in the amount of $53,353 plus 20% contingency for a total contract not-to-exceed amount of $64,024 for the Downtown Cardiff Accessibility Improvements project.
2019-04-17 Item 08E Downtown Cardiff Accessibility Improvements
8F.
Agreement with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction, Inc. (Blue Pacific) for the Pavement Rehabilitation and Roadway Sealing Project FY 2018-2019 (CS19A). Contact Person: Civil Engineer Milligan
Authorize the City Manager, or her designee to execute change orders for the Pavement Rehabilitation and Roadway Sealing – FY 2019-20 construction contract with Blue Pacific in an additional amount of $400,000, for a total contract not-to-exceed amount of $1,373,363.
2019-04-17 Item 08F Blue Pacific Agreement for Pavement Rehab & Roadway Sealing
8G.
Legislative position letter in support of AB 893. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the legislation position letter in support of AB 893 sent on March 17, 2019.
2019-04-17 Item 08G Legislative position letter in support of AB 893
8H.
Landscape Maintenance Services Agreement Amendment No. 3. Contact Person: Parks Operations Manager Saul
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 3 with Excel Landscape for Citywide Landscape Maintenance Services, in substantial form in consultation with the City Attorney, increasing the contract total from $9,612,733 to a total amount not to exceed $10,261,527.
2019-04-17 Item 08H Landscape Maintenance Services Agreement Amendment No. 3
8I.
Amendment No.1 for As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreements. Contact Person: Parks Operations Manager Saul
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 with Design Builders for As Needed Maintenance and General Services, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form, increasing the agreement by $40,000 for a three year agreement not to exceed $220,000. City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 with Geo Tech Construction Inc., in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form, reducing the agreement by $40,000 for a three-year agreement not to exceed $80,600.
2019-04-17 Item 08I Amendment No.1 for As Needed Maintenance and General Services Agreements
8J.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Keller
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
2019-04-17 Item 08J Mobility Report
8K.
Authorization to Conduct Proposition 218 Public Hearing on Solid Waste Rates. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
That City Council authorize staff to initiate the notification process and schedule a public hearing
to consider adoption of the new solid waste collection rates on June 19, 2019, in compliance
with Proposition 218 requirements.
2019-04-17 Item 08K EDCO Authorization to Hold Hearing on Solid Waste Rates
8L.
Amendment to City Arborist Consulting Services Agreement. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
Recommend Council authorize the City Manager, with the coordination of the City Attorney, execute Amendment Number 2 to the Agreement between the City and Dudek. Breakdown: 1) Increase the Fiscal Year 2018-19 amount by $29,298 for a not to exceed annual amount of $130,864; and 2) Extend the Agreement through June 30, 2020 in an annual amount not to exceed $134,790 for a not to exceed amount of $375,654.
2019-04-17 Item 08L Amendment to City Arborist Consulting Agreement
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
License Agreement with Gotcha Ride LLC to operate the North County Coastal Bike Share Pilot Program in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a license agreement with Gotcha Ride LLC in substantial form and to operate the North County Coastal Bike Share Pilot Program in the City of Encinitas.
2019-04-17 Item 10A Gotcha License Agreement
10B.
Final Community Choice Energy Technical Feasibility Study, and approval of legal services contract. Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
1) Accept the Community Choice Energy (CCE) Technical Feasibility Study (Study) completed for the Cities of Encinitas, Del Mar, Carlsbad and Oceanside as final; 2) Adopt Resolution 2019-25, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Declaring Intent to Pursue the formation of a Community Choice Energy Program"; 3) Adopt Resolution 2019-26, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget"; 4) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a cost share agreement between the cities of Encinitas, Del Mar, and Carlsbad (Parties) or other participating cities in substantial form and to share the cost for CCE Legal Services in the amount of $30,000, plus $3,000 contingency, from Richards Watson Gershon Law (RWG); and 5) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form for services with RWG to cover the cost of CCE Legal Services for the Partners in an amount not to exceed $33,000.
2019-04-17 Item 10B CCE Study
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Information report on the status of the Leucadia North Highway 101 Streetscape Project. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Receive the oral report and provide direction as necessary.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING POSSIBLE FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2019-04-17 Item 14 CITY MANAGER FOLLOW UP LOG
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON APRIL 24, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
